hero_heading: Your body already knows the way back to itself.
hero_sub: Root cause healing through body intelligence — working with the biofield, nervous system, and the emotional patterns that shape physical reality.
about_short: Jane is a healing facilitator certified in Kambo, ERT, Biofield Tuning, and Emotion & Body Code. Her path to this work came through her own body — years of chronic illness, a late Lyme disease diagnosis, and the slow, hard work of healing herself.
about_short_2: Every modality she offers found her before she ever offered it to anyone else.
scale_quote: I believe healing shouldn't only be available to those who can afford it.
scale_sub: A limited number of sliding scale spots are available each month.
scale_note: If cost is a barrier, reach out before you talk yourself out of it. We'll figure something out together.
booking_heading: Ready to come back to yourself?
booking_sub: Book a free 20-minute discovery call. We'll talk about where you are and figure out together where to start.
